conventions.cost_gate: descent psi(N)(k-1) <= 300 and level_n psi(N)(k-1) <= 1000 are HACS confirm gates (silent envelope, Console/Core/Confirm.h), not hard bounds; every script sets confirm = "yes"; cells outside are capped by this driver (rule 19 prediction, RSS watchdog, wall budget)
conventions.extraction: H^1/tors charpoly = chi_cusp^2 (x-1-p^{k-1})^c; chi_new(N) = chi_cusp(N)/prod_{d|N,d<N} chi_new(d)^sigma0(N/d); D-new part at DM = prod_{d|M} chi_new(dD)^sigma0(M/d)
conventions.k_2: symn.json RHS at k = 2 carries the Eisenstein factor (x-ell-1), added here for the comparison only
conventions.normalisation: classical a_p (no p^{k/2-1} rescaling); polynomials are charpolys of T_p on the D-new part of S_k(Gamma_0(DM)) (here M = 1: S_k(Gamma_0(D))^new), coefficient lists constant term first (as symn.json); k odd -> [1]
conventions.signs: charpoly of U_D only (no matrices): signs attach to Galois orbits = irreducible factors of the T_p charpoly; sign_status says whether this determines them (constant/unique/ambiguous); for 'ambiguous' the per-factor n_plus/n_minus are null and only the cell totals are exact; composite D: U_D = null with U_D_null_reason
